errors.text_span: This bar chart compares the performance of various large language models (LLMs) on two benchmark tests, MATH-500 and AIME24, under two different prompting strategies: Compute-Optimal Test-Time Scaling (TTS) and Chain-of-Thought (CoT). The chart is divided into six subplots: (a) and (d) for MATH-500, (b) and (e) for MATH-500 with different model sizes, and (c) and (f) for AIME24.
